purpose: Teach: 宝塚/グローブ/ジャンク/アリア/運勢/グレイ/悪人/グレン

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、宝塚歌劇のファンだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, that customer — apparently she's a Takarazuka Revue fan.
lines.style: Soft conspiratorial lean-in, hushed delight, savoring the little discovery.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、野球のグローブを新調されたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Mei, that customer apparently just treated himself to a brand-new baseball glove.
lines.style: Light and melodic over the counter, smiling mid-task, easy unhurried warmth.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お子様のジャンクフード好きで悩んでらっしゃるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: And that one's worried about her little one's junk-food habit, she said — poor thing.
lines.style: Gentle wry hush, a sympathetic little laugh tucked under the words.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ジャズのアリアがお好きだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Mei, apparently that customer loves arias — jazz ones, of all things.
lines.style: Warm unhurried delivery, a pleased hum coloring the middle of the line.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、毎朝運勢チェックされてるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: And she checks her horoscope every single morning, apparently.
lines.style: Amused whisper, eyebrows audibly raised, a tiny giggle held back at the end.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、グレイのジャケットをお気に入りだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Mei, that gray jacket he always wears? Apparently it's his favorite.
lines.style: Fond knowing tone, slowing to picture the jacket, soft smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、映画の悪人キャラがお好きだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: And apparently she loves the villains in movies — the villains, Aoi.
lines.style: Playful mock-scandal, hushed, a delighted little emphasis on the reveal.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、トランペッターのグレン・ミラーがお好きだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: And that customer adores Glenn Miller, Mei — the trumpeter, apparently.
lines.style: Warm wrapping-up tone, gentle downward settle, like closing a scrapbook for the day.
